title: Lucky Millinder band and Columbia recordings
summary: He was not long with Millinder in the 1930s; Hammond recorded for Columbia.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: How long were you with Lucky Millinder's band and when was that period? (To EK: Do you remember when he was with Lucky Millinder?)
He wasn't with him too long, were you?
When he left he was with Fletcher Henderson, then Lucky Millinder? You said John Hammond was doing all the recording of
all of the bands and so forth. That was with Columbia Records?
